author: Tonda
changelog: First version: low-data audio, offline small downloads, data meter, Smart Shuffle.
description: Low-data listening for Myspoti: tiny audio first, small downloads for offline, a data meter, and a true no-repeat Smart Shuffle.
name: MySpoti Lite

settings.description: Smallest uses the tiniest files, including free copies. Balanced uses your folder only. Best steps aside and lets Spotify play full quality.
settings.label: Lite quality

settings.label: Try free copies too

settings.description: Never play a song twice until every song in the list has played once.
settings.label: Smart Shuffle: no repeats

welcome.message: MySpoti Lite plays small files first so songs use little data, downloads small files for offline, and shuffles without repeats.
steps: In Myspoti, put MySpoti Lite above Spotify in Settings, Playback (audio) and Downloads.
Set Downloads quality to Small for the tiniest offline files.
Turn on Myspoti's own Data Saver and Low quality for Spotify streams.
Optional: add your own music folder URL in the extension settings.
